_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Out of my Mind#000.src: You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
Out of my Mind#000.dst: 아이들에게 이상한 생물들, 그보다 더 이상한 사람들, 그리고... 코코넛에 대한 흐릿한 기억까지 겪은 일을 들려준다.

Out of my Mind#001.src: Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
Out of my Mind#001.dst: 나무 위 집에 있는 {p} 아이들과 이야기하세요.

Out of my Mind#002.src: Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
Out of my Mind#002.dst: 너희 둘, 마을을 어슬렁대는 사람 얘기 들었어? 그 사람에 대한 이상한 소문을 들었거든...
Out of my Mind#002.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#003.src: Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
Out of my Mind#003.dst: 당연히 들었지, 온 마을이 그 얘기인데! 그 사람은 하루에 이를 한 번만 닦고, 정원 가꾸기 책을 좋아한대!
Out of my Mind#003.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#004.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumors seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be a mad scientist?
Out of my Mind#004.dst: 글쎄, 얘들아, 그 소문들 좀 억지 같지 않아? 다음엔 뭐야? 알고 보니 미친 과학자라도 된대?
Out of my Mind#004.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#005.src: Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
Out of my Mind#005.dst: 쉿, 조용히 해. 우리가 동화책 속에 사는 것도 아니잖아! 게다가 *정말* 미친 과학자라면, 이야기 속 미친 과학자들처럼 도시를 점령하려 들지 않겠어?
Out of my Mind#005.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#006.src: To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
Out of my Mind#006.dst: 내가 들은 다른 얘기들에 비하면 그건 별로 이상하지도 않아... 실험실이랑 "은둔자"에 대한 얘기도 있었거든.
Out of my Mind#006.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#007.src: I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
Out of my Mind#007.dst: 그거 게 종류 아니야? 어른들은 가끔 진짜 괴짜라니까.
Out of my Mind#007.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#008.src: Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
Out of my Mind#008.dst: 어, 낯선 사람이다! 언제부터 엿들은 거야? 엄마가 예의도 안 가르쳐 줬어?
Out of my Mind#008.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#009.src: Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
Out of my Mind#009.dst: 잠깐 Viola, 이건 기회야! 이 사람은 뭐든 해치울 것 같잖아, 사악한 소라게라도! 이 사람한테 소문이 진짜인지 알아봐 달라고 하면 돼!
Out of my Mind#009.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#010.src: Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
Out of my Mind#010.dst: 저기 내 친구들은 신경 쓰지 마, 맨날 저래. 그래도 Prentiss 말이 맞아. 그 수수께끼 남자가 누군지 알아낼 유일한 기회일지도 몰라!
Out of my Mind#010.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#011.src: It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
Out of my Mind#011.dst: 도시 남동쪽의 으스스한 폐허 옆에 있는 그 이상한 집을 살펴보는 게 좋겠어. 우리가 찾은 이 열쇠를 써 봐. 잃어버려도 기지에 여분이 있어.
Out of my Mind#011.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#012.src: Find the hidden door next to the gate near the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
Out of my Mind#012.dst: {p} 밖 덤불 유적 근처 관문 옆에 숨겨진 문을 찾으세요

Out of my Mind#013.src: Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
Out of my Mind#013.dst: [-{~},-{~}]에 있는 집 안으로 들어갈 방법을 찾으세요

Out of my Mind#014.src: Explore the hidden lab in search of information

Out of my Mind#015.src: Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
Out of my Mind#015.dst: 안녕, 낯선 이여! 나의 소박한 나무 집에 온 걸 환영해. 아늑하지? 분명 이 커피 한 잔이 생각날 거야-
Out of my Mind#015.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#016.src: Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
Out of my Mind#016.dst: 아, 그래, 난 상냥한 Ariodo, 친절한 동네 이웃이지. 나한테 무슨 볼일이야?
Out of my Mind#016.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#017.src: Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
Out of my Mind#017.dst: 납치? 밀렵? 이를 안 닦는다고?! 대체 누굴 말하는 거야, 그런 저질을... 나처럼 좋은 사람은 아닌 것 같은데.
Out of my Mind#017.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#018.src: Lets go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
Out of my Mind#018.dst: 가자, 더는 시간 뺏지 않게 출구까지 데려다줄게!
Out of my Mind#018.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#019.src: This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
Out of my Mind#019.dst: 여긴 네가 들어온 방이야. "Vivarium"이라고 부르지. 내가 지었는데 창의적이지? 아직 준비가 덜 된 애완동물들이 있어.
Out of my Mind#019.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#020.src: Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
Out of my Mind#020.dst: 뭘 위한 준비냐고? 말하면 깜짝 선물이 망치잖아? 큰 행사 전에 누가 알아채면 안 되지!
Out of my Mind#020.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#021.src: Let us go now, time is precious.
Out of my Mind#021.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#022.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
Out of my Mind#022.dst: 너 지금 이런 생각 하지? 어째서 나 같은 멋진 사람을 이제야 만났을까? 솔직히 넌 운이 지독히 나빴던 거야. 나 예전엔 세계를 여행했거든!
Out of my Mind#022.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#023.src: Oh, the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
Out of my Mind#023.dst: 아, 내가 가 본 곳들은 정말 멋졌어! 정글 깊숙한 곳부터 정글의 덜 깊은 곳, 심지어 우리 뒷마당까지, 탐험이라면 나도 꽤 했다고 자부해!
Out of my Mind#023.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#024.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {PlayerName}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
Out of my Mind#024.dst: {PlayerName}, 넌 요즘 내가 본 첫 번째 정상인이야. 최근에 나갔더니 아주 무례한 마을 사람들한테 아주 무례한 말을 들었지 뭐야!
Out of my Mind#024.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#025.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even to hide from! Strange people.
Out of my Mind#025.dst: 지난번 마을에 갔을 때도 텅 비어 있었는데, 다들 집에 숨어 있는 게 느껴졌어. 그렇게 날씨 좋은 날에 말이야. 숨을 이유도 없는데! 이상한 사람들이야.
Out of my Mind#025.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#026.src: I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
Out of my Mind#026.dst: 난 그냥 평범한 사람인데, 왜 아무도 날 알아주지 않을까? 넌 알아주지, 그렇지?
Out of my Mind#026.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#027.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books hours too! Here's one right now.
Out of my Mind#027.dst: 다 왔다, 도서관이야! 여기서 몇 년이고 보낼 수 있지만 누가 그럴 시간이 있겠어? 책 얘기라면 몇 시간이고 할 수 있어! 마침 여기 한 권 있네.
Out of my Mind#027.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#028.src: This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#028.dst: 이건 'Sweeney S. Greenville의 장황하고 고통스러운 죽음'인데, 정말 숨은 명작이야! 어느 날 갑자기 여기 나타나서 안 읽을 수가 없었지. 이야기는 Sweeney S. Greenville이...
Out of my Mind#028.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#029.src: We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
Out of my Mind#029.dst: 다 왔어! 바로 앞 출구로 나가. 오른쪽 복도는 신경 쓰지 마, 그냥 장식이야!
Out of my Mind#029.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#030.src: Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
Out of my Mind#030.dst: 언젠가 차나 커피 마시러 와서 책 얘기 길게 하자. 내 장황한 서평에 관심이 많아 보이던데! 밖에서 즐겁게 지내고, 잊지 마. 난 언제나 네 편이야!
Out of my Mind#030.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#031.src: The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back, friend, I can't do this alone!
Out of my Mind#031.dst: 땅이 흔들려... 이건 나중에 일어날 일이었는데! 돌아와, 친구, 나 혼자선 못 해!
Out of my Mind#031.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#032.src: Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
Out of my Mind#032.dst: 머리를 칠 기계를 만들어 원래대로 돌아오세요

Out of my Mind#033.src: Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
Out of my Mind#033.dst: 이 문 닫는 거 좀 도와줘, 안 그러면 내 깜짝 선물이 망한다고!
Out of my Mind#033.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#034.src: Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
Out of my Mind#034.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#035.src: Just stay here for one more momen...
Out of my Mind#035.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#036.src: Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
Out of my Mind#036.dst: 세상에, 유령? 잠깐, 설마 나의 믿음직한 친구인 네가 장난치는 거야? 아니라고? 그럼 진짜 문제네!
Out of my Mind#036.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#037.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shell hitting you square in the head!
Out of my Mind#037.dst: 기억나면 말인데, 우리가 문을 닫아 두자고 얘기하던 중에 갑자기 선반에서 무거운 게 떨어져 네 머리에 정통으로 맞았어!
Out of my Mind#037.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#038.src: I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
Out of my Mind#038.dst: 불은 불로 다스린다는 말을 들은 것 같아. 그러니 널 되돌릴 방법이 있어! 근데 넌 나한테 좀 무거우니까, 다른 방법을 생각해야 해.
Out of my Mind#038.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#039.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping someting heavier on your head for the second time.
Out of my Mind#039.dst: 흔들릴 때 내 기계 몇 대가 부서졌는데, 이 부품으로 네 머리에 더 무거운 걸 한 번 더 떨어뜨릴 뭔가를 만들 수 있을 거야.
Out of my Mind#039.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#040.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose where you want it to go and face.
Out of my Mind#040.dst: 그 논리대로라면 분명 다 잘될 거야. 자, 방법을 설명할게. 먼저 기계에 쓸 부품을 고르고, 그다음 놓을 위치와 방향을 정해.
Out of my Mind#040.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#041.src: The [Cart] can carry the coconut from one end of the platform to another for a few tiles, while the [Fan] can push the coconut even further.
Out of my Mind#041.dst: [Cart]는 코코넛을 발판 한쪽에서 다른 쪽으로 몇 칸 옮기고, [Fan]은 코코넛을 더 멀리 밀어 줘.
Out of my Mind#041.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#042.src: The [Hammer] is able to knock the coconut over a one space gap while the [Cannon] can shoot the coconut one grid up diagonally in the direction it is facing.
Out of my Mind#042.dst: [Hammer]는 코코넛을 한 칸짜리 틈 너머로 쳐 내고, [Cannon]은 코코넛을 바라보는 방향 대각선 위로 한 칸 쏘아 올려.
Out of my Mind#042.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#043.src: I think I hit my head too, so I'll need your help deciding where to place each part. You want to get the coconut across to the green tile, remember?
Out of my Mind#043.dst: 나도 머리를 부딪친 것 같으니 부품 위치는 네가 정해 줘. 코코넛을 초록색 칸까지 보내야 해, 알지?
Out of my Mind#043.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#044.src: You're back! To be quite honest, I didn't think that would work, but I'm glad it did!
Out of my Mind#044.dst: 돌아왔구나! 솔직히 될 줄 몰랐는데, 돼서 다행이야!
Out of my Mind#044.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#045.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all this shaking!
Out of my Mind#045.dst: 어서, 큰 문을 지나서 이 흔들림의 원인을 막아!
Out of my Mind#045.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#046.src: Find a way to destroy the plant monster, then return to the group in {p} at [-{~},-{~}] to report your findings
Out of my Mind#046.dst: 식물 괴물을 처치할 방법을 찾은 뒤, [-{~},-{~}]의 {p}에 있는 아이들에게 돌아가 알아낸 것을 보고하세요

Out of my Mind#047.src: Oh no no, this is not good! If I had known that my little pet has grown so much I would have rushed you out sooner. Now it is wilted...
Out of my Mind#047.dst: 아 안 돼 안 돼, 이건 곤란해! 내 작은 애완동물이 이렇게 자란 줄 알았으면 널 더 빨리 내보냈을 텐데. 이제 시들어 버렸어...
Out of my Mind#047.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#048.src: You did what you had to, though. I am sorry to say this friend, but I think I'll stay inside a little longer. Sorry, my only friend.
Out of my Mind#048.dst: 그래도 넌 해야 할 일을 했어. 이런 말 하긴 미안하지만, 친구, 난 안에서 좀 더 지낼 것 같아. 미안해, 나의 유일한 친구.
Out of my Mind#048.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#049.src: We'll surely meet again in the future, so don't be sad. I'll still be the one and only friendly neighbourhood neighbour when that moment comes, I promise. Goodbye now!
Out of my Mind#049.dst: 앞으로 분명 다시 만날 테니 슬퍼하지 마. 그때가 와도 난 여전히 하나뿐인 친절한 이웃일 거야, 약속해. 그럼 안녕!
Out of my Mind#049.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#050.src: You're back! You were gone for ages too, and what happened to your head? Who did the mystery man turn out to be?
Out of my Mind#050.dst: 돌아왔구나! 엄청 오래 걸렸네, 머리는 또 왜 그래? 그 수수께끼 남자는 누구였어?
Out of my Mind#050.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#051.src: That sounds ridiculous! Who could ever belie-
Out of my Mind#051.dst: 말도 안 돼! 누가 그걸 믿-
Out of my Mind#051.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#052.src: Wow that sounded just like in the stories, but it came from you, so it must be true!
Out of my Mind#052.dst: 우와, 딱 이야기 속 같은데, 네가 한 말이니까 분명 진짜야!
Out of my Mind#052.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#053.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I fell like we should make them our honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
Out of my Mind#053.dst: Todd, 넌 어떨지 모르지만, 이렇게 대단한 걸 알아냈으니 이 사람을 우리 클럽 명예 회원으로 삼아야 할 것 같아!
Out of my Mind#053.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#054.src: Why do I even try... You two would believe anything.
Out of my Mind#054.dst: 내가 뭘 기대하겠어... 너희 둘은 뭐든 믿잖아.
Out of my Mind#054.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#055.src: I'm pretty sure they mentioned something about being hit by coconut crabs, and just look at their head. One... two... two huge bumps!
Out of my Mind#055.dst: 분명 코코넛 크랩한테 맞았다고 했어. 머리 좀 봐. 하나... 둘... 커다란 혹이 두 개야!
Out of my Mind#055.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#056.src: Oh fine... whatever you say, Prentiss. I'm sure they'll bring you on some wacky adventures next time around!
Out of my Mind#056.dst: 아 그래... 네 말이 맞다 쳐, Prentiss. 다음엔 이 사람이 너를 엉뚱한 모험에 데려가겠지!
Out of my Mind#056.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#057.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you're got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
Out of my Mind#057.dst: Viola는 신경 쓰지 마. 이번엔 네가 주목받아서 오늘 좀 투정 부리는 거야. 아무튼 난 Prentiss 말에 찬성이야.
Out of my Mind#057.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#058.src: Thanks to you, we solved the case of the mystery man as well as the mystery house! For this I'd like to...
